title: Analista de Conteúdo
description:
Aqui no LIV, entendemos que os sentimentos são partes essenciais para a aprendizagem, por isso, a nossa missão é criar espaços de escuta e fala que ampliem a compreensão de si, do outro e do mundo, promovendo um aprendizado socioemocional de qualidade para todos. Para isso, buscamos pessoas que se identifiquem com o nosso propósito e compartilhem da nossa vontade de espalhar o Jeito LIV, impactando as comunidades escolares de todo o Brasil.

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Conteúdo que seja proativo(a), criativo(a), que goste de trabalhar em equipe, ame educação e tenha facilidade de escrita para ser parte da equipe de desenvolvimento de criação de conteúdo pedagógico e material didático do LIV

E aí, #VemSerLIVástico com a gente?

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar da elaboração e construção dos materiais e recursos pedagógicos (educação socioemocional);
  • Produção de material didático para a Educação básica (educação infantil ao ensino médio);
  • Revisão do material escrito visando melhor impactar o nosso público a partir de pesquisa e feedback;
  • Participar de reuniões de equipe e de criação de projetos;
  • Realizar pesquisas com professores, alunos e gestores;
  • Acompanhar palestras e formações;
  • Conduzir dinâmicas com equipes internas e externas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em psicologia, pedagogia, licenciaturas ou demais graduações ligadas a área da Educação;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar 40 horas semanais (contratação CLT), no modelo híbrido (nosso escritório fica em Botafogo, no Rio de Janeiro);
  • Ter facilidade para produzir textos que dialogue com diversos públicos (alunos, professores e gestores);
  • Ser criativo na elaboração de dinâmicas e atividades do universo de Educação Socioemocional;
  • Ser responsável no cumprimento de prazos e processos burocráticos da empresa;
  • Ser colaborativo e disponível para aprendizagem.

Não é essencial, mas vamos amar se você tiver:

  • Alguma especialização ou experiência na área de Educação/Psicologia/Educação Midiática;
  • Experiência na elaboração de material didático;
  • Familiaridade com dados e/ou processos de pesquisa;
  • Experiência em sala de aula.

Informações adicionais

Acreditamos que um time diverso é o caminho para cumprir a nossa missão de transformar vidas e o Brasil. Assim, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas que se identifiquem com grupos minorizados em todas as nossas posições.

Não podemos escolher o que sentimos, mas podemos aprender o que fazer com nossos sentimentos. Já pensou nisso?

Prazer, somos o Laboratório Inteligência de Vida, mas pode chamar de LIV Entendemos que os sentimentos são partes essenciais para a aprendizagem, por isso, a nossa missão é criar espaços de escuta e fala que ampliem a compreensão de si, do outro e do mundo, promovendo um aprendizado socioemocional de qualidade para todos.

Para isso, buscamos pessoas que se identifiquem com o nosso propósito e compartilhem da nossa vontade de espalhar o jeito LIV, impactando as comunidades escolares de todo o Brasil.

Vem com a gente nessa jornada?

Aqui você vai encontrar:

Pessoas colaborativas - Acreditamos que juntos somos capazes de encontrar as melhores soluções;

Crescimento com responsabilidade e propósito - Reconhecemos que a ética e o impacto pedagógico são inegociáveis no nosso dia a dia;

Cuidado e escuta com quem faz o LIV - Valorizamos o cuidado e o respeito como partes imprescindíveis do nosso trabalho, por isso somos empáticos e acolhedores;

Visão em movimento - Somos inquietos, propositivos e inovamos para entregar a melhor experiência socioemocional;

Compromisso com a nossa comunidade - Tomamos decisões a partir do que as nossas escolas têm a dizer, praticando a escuta ativa e a cultura de feedbacks.

title: Copeira
description:
A Zerezes nasceu do design, do seu olhar atento às pessoas, e da vontade de redesenhar o que não funciona.

Acreditamos que os óculos são uma ferramenta de expressão do nosso estilo e personalidade, mas sabemos que essa não é a forma com ele é percebido pelas pessoas, que enxergam os óculos como algo funcional e pouco atraente.

Queremos transformar o jeito que as pessoas compram e se relacionam com seus óculos de grau, porque achamos que dessa maneira, melhoramos não somente como elas se veem, mas também como se relacionam com o mundo.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Copeira e a missão dessa posição é garantir a organização, limpeza e bom funcionamento da copa e áreas de apoio, oferecendo suporte às rotinas do escritório e contribuindo para um ambiente acolhedor, funcional e bem cuidado para colaboradores e visitantes.

  • Preparar e organizar café, água, chás e demais itens de consumo do escritório;

  • Apoiar na organização de salas de reunião, incluindo preparo de café/água quando necessário;
  • Controlar e sinalizar necessidade de reposição de insumos (café, açúcar, copos descartáveis, etc.);
  • Apoiar demandas simples de organização e limpeza de áreas comuns;
  • Zelar pela conservação dos materiais e equipamentos utilizados;
  • Cumprir normas de higiene, organização e segurança do ambiente de trabalho.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino fundamental completo;
  • Diferencial: experiência prévia como copeira, auxiliar de serviços gerais ou função similar;
  • Organização, proatividade e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Boa comunicação e postura colaborativa.

description:

Join our Subsea & Surface Pressure Systems Team
Baker Hughes is the leading energy technology company, who delivers across the energy value chain through our market-leading business segments. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries. Our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward Making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

  • Have 7+ years of experience with engineering processes, methods, and project execution practices
  • Have knowledge of the Subsea Systems Engineering lifecycle, including NPI, tendering, project engineering, SIT, commissioning, and operations.

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:

We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options
  • Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
  • Tailored financial programs
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits

About Us:
We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.

title: Regulatory Senior Analyst
description:
The Regulatory Senior Analyst will be responsible for ensuring regulatory compliance for offshore operations and projects, defining deliverable scopes and deadlines, and supporting engineering, sustainability, safety, project management, and operations teams. This position will coordinate regulatory requirements, consolidate technical documentation, assess compliance risks, support audits and inspections, and implement action plans to address findings. The role contributes directly to maintaining operational licenses, preventing non‑compliance, avoiding fines or interdictions and ensuring alignment with internal schedules, budgets and applicable Brazilian authorities' requirements.
Responsibilities
Define the scope and deadlines for deliverables that sustain compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, observing production schedules and budgets
Support the definition of responsibilities and resources to achieve regulatory compliance efficiently, observing the BWE organization charts and budgets
Incorporate lessons learned to BWE, set action plans to prevent or address audit findings, notifications, and conditions to operate imposed by the Authorities
Collaborate with engineering, sustainability, safety, project management, and operations to ensure awareness of regulatory requirements, build compliance, and fulfill BWE schedules.
Ensure that compliance-related tasks are executed efficiently, facilitating licenses and approvals, as well as preventing fines and interdictions
Consolidate engineering document lists, including all tech safety studies that are required to grant and sustain licenses and approvals needed to operate
Assess the content of engineering, tech safety, and other management system documents to provide proper support and guidance to achieve compliance.
Follow up on specific discussions and execution wherever assigned to ensure proper incorporation of regulatory compliance requirements and related risk
Support activities to implement BWE strategy and scope for internal regulatory compliance self-assessment, inspections, and audits to prevent project schedule delays, interdictions and fines
Track, manage, and ensure proper closure and documentation of regulatory-related action items.
Perform and/or guide inspections and audits of BWE facilities to assess and ensure proper compliance with regulatory and statutory requirements
Organize and coordinate internal preparations for regulatory audits
Flag to the Regulatory and Institutional Affairs Manager always when a potential critical non-conformance is identified or delays in regulatory compliance may delay schedules or not follow the original budgets
Support all other regulatory-related activities when required
Requirements
Education
Engineering degree
Experience
Minimum 3 years of experience with regulatory requirements applied to offshore platforms.
Experience fulfilling requirements for ANP shipyard audits.
Experience responding to ANP conditions to operate
Knowledge of Class, Flag, and Navy requirements
Knowledge
Good understanding and knowledge of Offshore systems
Familiar with engineering/industry standards such as API, ASME, ASTM, NACE etc
Fluent in English and Portuguese (oral and written)

title: Gender and Urban Safety Consultant
description:
Result of Service

The Gender and Urban Safety Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Terms of Reference. The Consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Home based

Expected duration

Two (2) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Since 2017, the project Urban, Sustainable, and Inclusive Prosperity in the State of Alagoas – An Integrated Initiative (known as "Visão Alagoas 2030"), a partnership between the State Government and UN-Habitat, has strengthened institutional capacity to plan and implement state public policies aimed at sustainable urban development. Among the initiatives to be implemented, the project will provide specialized technical assistance to strengthen the Policy to Address Domestic and Family Violence against Women ("Alagoas Lilás", in Portuguese), a permanent and intersectoral state public policy established in 2025, aimed at addressing violence against women in the state of Alagoas. The policy is coordinated by the State Secretariat for Women and implemented in an integrated and coordinated manner by state secretariats responsible for carrying out a set of actions. Within this framework, the State Secretariat for Education is responsible for: (i) incorporating themes related to gender equality and violence prevention into teacher training programs and the curriculum of the state public education system; (ii) carrying out educational campaigns in public schools; and (iii) developing educational materials and pedagogical projects with a focus on gender and human rights. In this context, as a means of strengthening the implementation of the Alagoas Lilás policy in state schools, the project will deliver a training course on gender, urban violence prevention, and the safe use of public spaces, targeting the technical teams of the state secretariats involved in the policy, with particular emphasis on the teaching staff of the State Secretariat for Education. The main objective of the training course is to strengthen conceptual and applied understanding of gender, the right to the city, and violence prevention, contributing to the identification of inequalities and situations of gender-based violence in urban and educational contexts, as well as to the incorporation of preventive and inclusive approaches into public policies and pedagogical practices. The course shall address, among other topics: (i) conceptual alignment on gender, gender-based violence, and the right to the city; (ii) strategies and public policies aimed at preventing gender-based violence; (iii) gender-sensitive urban planning and urban and environmental factors associated with perceptions of (in)security; and (iv) the role of schools in preventing multiple forms of violence, with a focus on urban safety and the home–school commute. Other topics related to the central theme may be incorporated into the course syllabus as necessary to achieve the proposed objectives. The course shall also ensure conceptual alignment with the guidelines of the Sustainable Development Goals, the New Urban Agenda, and the objectives of the Alagoas Lilás policy. The course will be delivered in-person in Maceió, with a total workload of eight (8) hours, conducted over a full day (morning and afternoon). Approximately 60 participants are expected, including representatives from the State Secretariat for Women, the State Secretariat for Education, the Steering Committee of the Alagoas Lilás policy, and other state secretariats related to the thematic area. At the end of the training, participants are expected to have the potential to act as multipliers of the references, methodologies, and good practices shared, contributing to the strengthening of state initiatives aimed at addressing multiple forms of violence in the state of Alagoas. In addition to the training materials, to be provided in slide presentation format during the course, a toolkit shall be developed to support the dissemination and adaptation of the content in state public schools and other state-level initiatives related to the theme. The toolkit shall include a set of technical and pedagogical materials, such as key concepts, reference guides and methodologies, practical examples, and guidance on the dissemination and adaptation of the approaches addressed throughout the training. Following the completion of the course, an activity report shall be prepared, including a systematization of the content and agenda, the methodology adopted, the dynamics applied, the profile of participants, the results of self-assessment instruments, and the lessons learned throughout the activity. To properly implement this initiative, a Gender and Urban Safety Consultant is required to design and deliver the course, ensuring the technical quality of the content, the pedagogical coherence of the training, and the integration of gender, urban safety, and right-to-the-city approaches. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Gender and Urban Safety Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Gender and Urban Safety Consultant will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Develop the training materials, in slide presentation format, covering the objectives, agenda, methodology to be adopted, contents to be addressed, as well as the practical and interactive activities to be applied, among other aspects necessary for the proper delivery of the course. b) Prepare technical support materials for the training, containing key concepts related to the subject matter presented in a glossary format, as well as a compilation of practical guides, methodologies, national and international good practices, and other relevant reference documents. c) Design and deliver the training course, in coordination with the UN-Habitat team and the Government of the State of Alagoas. d) Ensure the integration of theoretical and practical content related to gender, the right to the city, and violence prevention, promoting applied reflections within urban, educational, and public management contexts. e) Systematize the results of the training course, including a description of the content and agenda, the methodology adopted, the dynamics applied, the profile of participants, the results of self-assessment instruments, and the lessons learned throughout the activity, in accordance with the template to be provided by the UN-Habitat team. f) Ensure the adoption of ethical principles in the delivery of the training, particularly regarding active listening, respect for diversity, and the promotion of a safe, inclusive, and participatory learning environment. g) Participate in alignment, monitoring, and technical validation meetings with the UN-Habitat team and the Government of the State of Alagoas. h) Develop reports following ABNT guidelines, ensuring alignment with UN-Habitat's quality standards and project requirements. The Consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The Consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Gender and Urban Safety Consultant shall assist in the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1 – Capacity-Building Training Package on Gender and Urban Violence Prevention Description: The training materials, in slide presentation format (Canva or Power Point), shall cover the objectives, agenda, methodology to be adopted, contents to be addressed, as well as the practical and interactive activities to be applied, among other aspects necessary for the proper delivery of the course. In addition to the course teaching materials, a document in Word format, between 15 and 25 pages, shall be prepared, including key concepts related to the subject matter in a glossary format and a compilation of practical guides, methodologies, national and international good practices, as well as other reference documents. This material will be used to compose the toolkit to be organized by the UN-Habitat team and made available to participants after the completion of the course. Expected delivery date: 20 days after signing the contract. Product 2 – Activity Report of the training on gender, urban violence prevention, and the safe use of public spaces Description: The Activity Report shall be prepared after the completion of the course and shall include a systematization of the course content and agenda, the adopted methodology, the applied activities and dynamics, the participants profile, the results of the self-assessment instruments, and the lessons learned throughout the activity, in accordance with the template provided by the UN-Habitat team. Expected delivery date: 45 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Postgraduate degree (Latu Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Urban Planning, Architecture and Urbanism, Social Science, Political Science, Law, International Relations, or related fields is required, or additional four (4) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
• Bachelor's degree in Social Science, Political Science, Law, International Relations, Architecture and Urbanism or related fields. Work experience:
• Minimum six (6) years of professional and/or academic experience in gender and ur-ban safety in Brazil is required.
• Good knowledge of international, national, and subnational good practices in gender-responsive urban planning is desirable.
• Experience in capacity building and training of multidisciplinary teams in the public sec-tor is desirable.
• Previous experience within the UN system is desirable. Skills:
• Strong capacity to deliver training for education professionals and/or public sector programmatic staff is required.
• Ability to conduct theoretical and practical activities using agile methodologies and inclusive, participatory approaches is desirable.
• Excellent written and spoken Portuguese is required.
• Good command of technological tools, such as Microsoft Windows and Microsoft Office, is required. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.

Additional Information

Travel details: The Consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. title: Business Development Manager
description:
medtechrec is partnered with a growing, privately held global medical device organisation specialising in sports medicine to recruit a Business Development Manager to support continued expansion across Brazil.

The organisation operates internationally and combines strong commercial growth with a collaborative, people-led culture. This role sits at the centre of the regional commercial strategy and plays a critical part in supporting clinicians, partners, and internal stakeholders.

Position Overview


The Business Development Manager acts as the key link between the companys product portfolio, its commercial partners, and the clinical community. As the regional subject-matter expert, the role combines deep product knowledge, market intelligence, and partner enablement to ensure solutions are clearly understood, effectively positioned, and confidently adopted.

Working closely with the Business Development Manager, the Product Specialist supports regional sales strategy through technical expertise, pricing insight, and strong relationship management.

Key Responsibilities


Product Expertise & Market Insight

  • Serve as the regional product expert, maintaining in-depth knowledge of product features, clinical applications, and supporting evidence.
  • Monitor competitive activity and market trends to support pricing strategy and commercial decision-making.
  • Provide data-driven insights to the Business Development Manager on pricing opportunities and challenges.

Partner & Customer Enablement

  • Support distributor partners in developing and executing effective go-to-market strategies.
  • Deliver structured product training and technical presentations to partners, clinicians, and internal teams.
  • Act as the first point of contact for complex clinical or technical product enquiries.

Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with distributors, partners, and end-user clinicians.
  • Represent the organisation professionally in the field, acting as a consistent brand ambassador.

Sales & Strategic Support

  • Collaborate closely with the Business Development Manager to support regional sales planning and execution.
  • Provide technical and clinical support throughout the sales cycle to progress commercial opportunities.
  • Prepare technical documentation and support responses for tenders.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing to support the development of sales tools, campaigns, and educational materials.
  • Partner with Product Management to relay structured field insights that inform future product development.
  • Ensure effective communication of market and customer feedback to internal stakeholders.

Candidate Profile

  • Bachelors degree in Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 3 years experience in a Product Specialist, clinical support, or similar role within sports medicine.
  • Strong ability to communicate complex technical or clinical information clearly and persuasively.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate market data into actionable insights.
  • Proactive, organised, and comfortable operating autonomously in a field-based role.
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency is a strong advantage.

Whats on Offer

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Opportunity to play a pivotal role in a high-growth international medical device organisation.
  • Supportive, collaborative working environment.
  • Clear scope for professional development and long-term career progression.

title: Analista de Gestão
description:
REQUISITOS MANDATÓRIOS

EXPERIÊNCIA

  • 4 (quatro) anos de experiência em atividades similares ao escopo dos serviços, sujeito à aprovação da fiscalização do contrato.
  • Conhecimento intermediário dos softwares do pacote Office;

  • Conhecimento dos módulos CO, MM e HR do SAP e BW;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, Lean,etc);
  • Conhecer metodologia 5W1H;
  • Conhecimentos dos softwares MIRO, Vision e outros relacioanados ao mapeamento de processo.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI e Spotfire para tratamento de informações e emissão de relatórios gerenciais.

ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Monitorar e controlar processos;
  • Elaborar e/ou revisar e/ou manter atualizados os padrões existentes;
  • Divulgar e Planejar Treinamentos;
  • Planejar, cadastrar e monitorar a realização dos VCP (verificação de conformidade dos padrões) nos sistemas corporativos;
  • Analisar, apoiar e monitorar o tratamento de anomalias;
  • Fazer análise crítica e proposição de melhoria dos processos;
  • Monitorar o cumprimento de planos de ação em sistemas informatizados, incluindo análise, controle, diligenciamento junto aos envolvidos, tratamento de pendências e planos para saneamento do backlog, encaminhando relatórios atualizados às gerências;
  • Fazer a gestão de Bens Patrimoniais e controle do processo de inventário de bens patrimoniais (BP);
  • Emitir, acompanhar, diligenciar e prestr informações diversas no gerenciamento de sistemas e banco de dados, incluindo a ferramenta de BI (Business Intelligence);
  • Monitorar e controlar pendências, responsáveis e ações para diminuição do backlog;
  • Suportar a gestão em apresentações, minutas de documentos, reuniões, atas, relatórios e gerência da rotina;
  • Fazer apontamento de frequência nos sistemas da Companhia (SAF e SAP) e planejamento de férias dos empregados (SPF);
  • Mapear processos, contemplando: Metodologia de execução de cada serviço; Mapeamento do fluxo das atividades, conforme metodologia 5W2H; Desenho dos processos; Fluxogramas; Textos descritivos; Identificação de tarefas críticas; Minutar padrão para o sistema de gestão;
  • Planejar e o controlar de gastos com investimento (Capex) e o Orçamento Anual de Investimentos (OAI);
  • Outras atividades similares de mesma complexidade e escopo.

Sobre a CAPCO:

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões. 
Pensamos, em conjunto, sempre em ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social através de comitês internos geridos pela nossa comunidade interna, como os grupo de Mulheres, Pessoas Com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras, LGBTQIAPN+, Parentalidade, Gerações, entre outros.

ESCOLARIDADE

ATRIBUIÇÕES
Fiscalização do cumprimento das cláusulas contratuais relacionadas ao licenciamento ambiental e meio ambiente nas obras e operações;
Revisão e verificação da documentação de saúde ocupacional fornecida pela empresa executora da obra, garantindo que esteja em conformidade com os requisitos legais e contratuais;
Participação em auditorias internas e externas, avaliando a implementação das práticas de saúde ocupacional conforme estipulado nos contratos;
Comunicação à Fiscalização e à empresa executora da obra de quaisquer desvios ou não conformidades observadas nas práticas de Saúde e Segurança;
Participação em reuniões periódicas com a Fiscalização e a empresa executora da obra para discutir questões de Saúde e Segurança relacionadas aos contratos;
Assessoramento técnico e análises no registro e acompanhamento das licenças, autorizações e condicionantes ambientais no sistema LA+, ou equivalente;
Atuação nos processos de obtenção de licenças ambientais e autorizações ambientais que se fizerem necessárias para Implementação do empreendimento junto aos Órgãos Ambientais pertinentes;
Assessoramento técnico nas reuniões de comitê de SMS, análise crítica, PAD, etc. preparando material necessário, propondo soluções e monitoramento do cumprimento das ações estabelecidas;
Assessoramento técnico e emissão de análises e pareceres no acompanhamento de cronogramas de projeto considerando os prazos de atendimento às condicionantes, validade das licenças e autorizações ambientais;
Assessoramento técnico e emissão de análises e pareceres nas atividades de campo e análise de relatórios de contratos de serviços ambientais, tais como: reposição florestal, resgate e monitoramento de fauna, gerenciamento de áreas contaminadas, áreas degradadas etc;
Assessoramento técnico e emissão de laudos, análises e pareceres para atividades com intervenção e supressão de vegetação nativa, inventário florestal, reposição florestal, identificação de espécies arbóreas isoladas, com conhecimentos em áreas de manguezal e carcinofauna;
Realização de Auditoria Comportamental, de forma alinhada ao procedimento interno.
Sobre a CAPCO
Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões.
Pensamos, em conjunto, sempre em ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social através de comitês internos geridos pela nossa comunidade interna, como os grupo de Mulheres, Pessoas Com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras, LGBTQIAPN+, Parentalidade, Gerações, entre outros.

title: Procurement Assistant
description:
This job is with United Nations, an inclusive employer and a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community. Please do not contact the recruiter directly.
Result of ServiceThe Procurement Assistant reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference, supporting the administrative and procurement implementation of projects and initiatives. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the Operational Team of UN-Habitat in Rio de Janeiro and HQs.
Work LocationRio de Janeiro, RJ, Brazil
Expected durationSix (6) months, with possibility of renewal
Duties and ResponsibilitiesBackground The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. To meet with greater demand for projects' implementation, the office of Rio de Janeiro is looking for a Procurement Assistant that will be focusing on Brazil initiatives. The professional will be asked to assist the office team by contributing to the administrative and procurement of projects and initiatives. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Procurement Assistant reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Procurement Assistant will support the implementation of the projects in Brazil, with the following responsibilities: a. Support the administrative implementation of projects and initiatives, ensuring compliance with organizational policies and procedures. b. Support procurement processes for goods, services, and works, ensuring full compliance with organizational procurement rules, policies, and ethical standards. c. Plan, manage, and monitor procurement activities in line with approved project workplans, budgets, and timelines under supervision. d. Support the preparation of procurement documentation, including solicitation documents, evaluations, contracts, and purchase orders. e. Support procurement planning with programme, finance, and operations teams to ensure timely delivery and budget alignment. f. Help vendor sourcing, market research, and supplier evaluations to ensure value for money, transparency, and fairness. g. Monitor contract implementation, including deliverables, timelines, amendments, and closure, in coordination with relevant units. h. Maintain accurate and complete procurement records and ensure proper filing in corporate systems. i. Provide guidance and technical support to programme teams on procurement procedures and requirements. j. Identify procurement risks and propose mitigation measures to strengthen compliance and efficiency. k. Contribute to continuous improvement of procurement processes, tools, and templates. l. Assist in budget planning, monitoring, and revisions, including tracking expenditures against approved budgets, specially in relation to procurement. m. Support and follow up on financial transactions, such as payments, advances, reimbursements, and vendor contracts. n. Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial and administrative records for projects and operations. o. Organize and archive all documents and information relevant to project administration. p. Support the team through audits and other administrative and financial compliance checks. q. Monitor financial reporting timelines and contribute to the preparation of financial reports for internal and external stakeholders. r. Support audits and financial reviews by ensuring availability and organization of required documentation. s. Be responsible of for inventory and warehouse management. t. Write official letters in Portuguese. u. Be responsible for keeping information organized and accessible. v. Participate in missions as requested. w. Carry out other activities requested by the Head of Office and/or Program Officer within the framework of this consultancy, without prejudice to fulfilling their responsibilities. m. Prepare reports to partners, internal reports, etc. at various stages of the projects. n. Perform other duties which may be requested by the supervisor. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Procurement Assistant shall support the Program Officers in the proper planning and management of programmes' implementation related to the office's project portfolio, according to the stated responsibilities. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office of monthly activities' report.
Qualifications/special skillsEducation
Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Public Administration, Administration, Economics, or related fields is required, or additional three (3) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Work experience
A minimum of three (3) years of experience in program' implementation and projects in public administration or international organizations, administrative and financial issues, and/or related areas is required.
Demonstrated experience in administrative and finance is required.
Work experience within the United Nations System is desirable.
International experience is desirable, particularly in the field of international cooperation for development, urban development, and project management. Skills
Good computer skills in Office Package (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook) are required.
Mastery of technological tools and use of software and online platforms is required.
Good knowledge of project management methodologies is desirable. Competencies
Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.
Languages
English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of English and/or Spanish is desirable.
Additional InformationTravel details: The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. It is required for all the curricular information to be inserted in the system, which may take a few hours. Only complete applications in English will be considered. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence. Due to the volume of applications received, receipt of applications cannot be acknowledged individually. Only short-listed applicants will be contacted. Cover memo (maximum 1 page)

title: agente portaria  acolhedor
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II.
A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.
Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.
O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.
Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Realizar a segurança da instituição, rondando suas dependências e observando a entrada e saída de pessoas ou materiais, garantindo a segurança dos empregados, pacientes e o patrimônio físico do hospital.

Experiência mínima de 06 meses na função

Trabalhamos para que as pessoas vivam tranquilamente, tanto em seu ambiente físico quanto no digital, a fim de gerar um impacto positivo em sua vida pessoal e profissional.

Toda nossa história não seria possível sem um time de heróis e por isso desenvolvemos diariamente programas específicos para atrair novos talentos e promovemos a carreira dos nossos profissionais com treinamentos contínuos e oportunidades internas de crescimento.

Trabalhamos todos os dias para oferecer segurança inovadora com base nas soluções mais avançadas do mercado. No Brasil, o Grupo Prosegur conta com três linhas de negócio: Segurpro, Prosegur Cash e Cipher. Cada um de nós enxerga o mundo de formas diferentes. Mas uma coisa deve ser comum a todos: o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências garantem um ambiente diferenciado de trabalho

O Programa Somos Todos Heróis - Diversidade e Respeito vem para fortalecer e apoiar o nosso posicionamento a favor do Respeito e da Inclusão e para trazer conhecimento e conscientização a todos os nossos Heróis. O time de Infraestrutura é responsável por organizar, manter e evoluir as diferentes plataformas que constituem a base da operação da empresa. Da organização dos serviços de computação na nuvem à segurança da informação. Estamos à procura de um Especialista DevOps apaixonado por tecnologia para integrar a nossa equipe de TI. Se você é especialista em implementar, gerenciar e aprimorar práticas de DevOps, contribuindo para a entrega contínua de software e eficiência operacional, queremos te conhecer.

  • Desenvolver e manter infraestrutura como código (laC) usando Terraform;

  • Experiência em configuração de pipelines de CI/CD usando Gitlab;

  • Habilidades de comunicação eficazes e capacidade de trabalho em equipe.

Será um diferencial

title: Coordenador de Marketing
description:
Nossa Cultura
Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:
Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.
O Time De Renda Extra
O Renda Extra é o programa da Ton, empresa do grupo Stone, criado para impulsionar o empreendedorismo e gerar renda extra de forma acessível, legítima e sustentável.
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa estratégica, criativa e com visão de marca, que queira construir e fortalecer a presença do Renda Ton para os parceiros, ampliando seu alcance e consolidando sua reputação no ecossistema.

Fornecer ao parceiro materiais de suporte à venda, adequado ao modelo de venda de cada um (loja, mídias pagas).
Cuidar da jornada do parceiro.

Responsável por toda a comunicação verbal e visual com a base de parceiros;

Garantir o melhor modelo e tom das comunicações, bem como os canais adequados;
Monitorar os resultados e evoluir o processo;
Estabelecer e monitorar o branding das nossas lojas.
Responsável pelo processo de marca ligado à abertura de lojas;

Experiência em Marketing, com atuação sólida em estratégias B2B e B2C;

About Foundey
Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States.
We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences.
With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.
The Opportunity
We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer.
This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.
Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.
Requirements
Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.
Preferred Qualifications
5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.
Why Join Us?
At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide.
You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

SEO Outreach Manager at BairesDev

title: Senior Email Marketing Manager
description:
About Darkroom
Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.
At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.
Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.
What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.
About The Role
We are hiring a Senior Manager, Retention—a seasoned CRM strategist and operator who brings equal parts creativity, technical depth, and leadership maturity to the table. This is not a maintenance role; it requires strategic ownership, hands-on execution, and a bias for measurable impact. You'll lead a team of lifecycle marketing experts to build sophisticated email, SMS, and loyalty programs that drive retention, increase LTV, and power sustained growth for a portfolio of fast-scaling e-commerce brands. This role demands sharp customer insight to turn data into strategy, comfort with complexity, and the ability to influence clients and internal stakeholders alike. You'll report to our Director of Retention and collaborate closely with Performance, Creative, and Strategy teams to deliver cohesive, cross-channel campaigns rooted in data and customer psychology.
Darkroom is a career accelerator for retention marketers who want to do the best work of their careers—operating at the intersection of personalization, loyalty, and performance-driven innovation.
This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal, Mexico, Brazil, and Spain.
You Should Apply if this sounds like you:
You're passionate about e-commerce and digital marketing. You're immersed in the world of direct-to-consumer growth marketing. We're looking for an expert Senior Manager, Retention to join our team In this role, you will join a growing team within the Retention Marketing Department to strategically develop customized CRM and retention marketing strategies that help our clients grow and scale through email and SMS, subscription, and loyalty programs.
7+ years of work experience in digital marketing.
You immerse yourself in scaling personalized D2C/e-commerce email and SMS programs that build deep customer relationships for clients.
You can creatively message the value propositions of any brand's product catalog to create email and SMS campaigns that customers find to be engaging, informative, and persuasive.
You're passionate about developing creative customer journeys and loyalty programs that drive loyalty and lifetime value.
You have experience working in Klaviyo (or a similar ESP's) including list segmentation, lifecycle drip automations, and triggered events. Additionally, you have knowledge of Shopify and their tech stack options such as Privy, JustUno, Yotpo, Octane AI etc.
You have developed SMS and loyalty programming strategies and have experience working with SMS platforms such as Attentive, PostScript, SMSBump, or Klaviyo.
You're used to working in a fast paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
You love making data driven decisions and excel at turning analytics into actionable SMS and email strategies that drive client revenue.
You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.
You have experience developing and executing customer loyalty programs that enhance LTV.
You've had at least one direct report before and exceptional leadership skills working with cross-functional teams.
Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.
A Day in the Life:
Serve as the senior point of contact for select clients, working to develop best-in-class retention strategies. On a weekly basis, you will meet with clients to discuss current and future initiatives.
Develop strategic campaign calendars and prioritize projects and initiatives designed to scale your clients' email and SMS programs.
Provide support and guidance to help Retention Specialists analyze data, develop winning retention strategies and create reports for clients happiness.
Project manage and delegate client tasks to your team, consisting of both specialists and designers. Review all client briefs and designs for approval before they are sent to the client.
Coordinate cross-departmentally with the Performance Marketing and Strategy teams to develop cohesive and creative campaigns that drive client growth.
Assign segmentation and QA email and SMS campaigns ensuring flawless delivery to customer audiences.
Report on strategic KPIs for clients, creating insights and actionable recommendations to grow client retention engagement and revenue.
Execute on automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.
Working at Darkroom
Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.
We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you'll thrive here.
Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in-office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.
Equal Opportunity Statement
Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões.

title: Intern (Offshore desk)
description:
Company Overview

Offering a complete ecosystem of maritime services, including broking, finance, port services and research, Clarksons is at the heart of global shipping. Our unrivalled reach, expertise, and depth of experience, combined with leading research, enables us to partner with clients across every sector to meet the demands of the world's rapidly evolving maritime, offshore, trade and energy markets. Building on our unique heritage and harnessing our insights to see further, faster, we work with our clients and communities to create strategies that have a positive impact on the industry and the world around us. Dedicated to excellence, it's our people that drive success for our clients.

To understand more including day-to-day life at Clarksons, visit us at

Division Overview

The Offshore group has vast expertise in brokerage and serves the shipping and offshore industry worldwide by providing shipbrokering services within chartering, sale and purchase and contracting of ships and offshore units. We maintain a strong relationship and extensive communication with the majority of the world's leading shipowners and oil companies which represents a considerable source of business opportunities.

Discover more at

Role Summary

We have a fantastic opportunity for a college student to join our Offshore team in Rio De Janeiro. The person in this role will carry out post-fixture operations and accounts receivable duties. This includes being responsible for collecting information from each fixture from the Offshore desk, inputting details into an internal system, and producing on-demand reports for the Accounts team. You will be required to liaise with brokers and the Accounts department, with a focus on being a key point of contact for the Accounts Receivables team.

The successful candidate should be organized, highly responsive and diligent, able to apply strong attention to detail and accuracy. This role would suit someone who is self-motivated and proactive and can deliver a variety of tasks in a busy and fast-paced environment. We are looking for someone who is able to work autonomously to deadlines and enjoys being a valued member of the team.

What you'll be doing

Post-Fixture Operations Duties

  • Carry out various post-fixture duties.
  • Check all documents related to the fixtures are in accordance with the standards and needs.
  • Request fixture documents from brokers and/or clients, managing internal and external communication.
  • Input and update relevant data from the fixtures into internal systems, including contractual, financial documentation.
  • Follow up vessels 'on-hire' and 'off-hire' with brokers and clients.
  • Check hire invoices, ensuring they are accurate and issued on time, and chase for payment if needed.

Accounts Receivable Duties

  • Organizing, raising and processing monthly and ad-hoc invoicing to clients;
  • Produce Accounts Receivable ad-hoc reports for the Offshore and Accounts departments.

General Duties

  • Provide administrative assistance to our Offshore chartering team in general terms.
  • Addition ad / hoc duties as needed in order to meet the needs of the business.

What we're looking for

We welcome applications from candidates who share our Company Values and key attributes, as follows:

  • Integrity and respect
    – acting thoughtfully and ethically to do the right thing in accordance with Conduct Rules, and to promote and foster a respectful work environment for all.
  • Drive
    – self-motivation and the desire and commitment to succeed, deliver excellence and make positive change.
  • Relationship building
    – excellent communicator to effectively build strong, long-lasting relationships with colleagues, clients and others.
  • Collaboration
    – working well with others across diverse backgrounds to share information, develop skills and deliver results.
  • Resilience
  • persisting and adapting to changing or difficult situations, and adopting a positive and focused approach.
  • Smart
  • problem-solving and analytical abilities, with a curious and inquisitive mind, and an openness to new ideas.

Other requirements

title: Oficial Eletricista
description:
Executar serviços de manutenção preventiva e corretiva de INSTALAÇÕES, inspecionando sistemas elétricos, efetuando a troca de lâmpadas, luminárias e reatores, verificando o estado de interruptores, tomadas e condutores, passando cabos por conduletes, instalando eletrocalhas, eletrodutos e dutos subterrâneos e realizando outras tarefas, visando o atendimento às necessidades do Contrato. Executar a manutenção elétrica preventiva e corretiva de MÁQUINAS E EQUIPAMENTOS (Aparelhos e equipamentos hospitalares, Back Lights, Postes de Iluminação, Boilers, Bombas hidráulicas, Tele Tubos, máquinas de lavar louça, cafeteiras, liquidificadores, fornos, etc. ), lubrificando peças e trocando circuitos, comandos e motores, a fim de possibilitar o pleno funcionamento da infra-estrutura do Contrato. Executar a manutenção preventiva de QUADROS ELÉTRICOS de BAIXA Tensão, isolando ferramentas, reapertando e trocando disjuntores e borneiras de circuitos, instalando contactores, verificando condições de fios e cabos, efetuando medições de tensão e corrente elétrica através de aparelho Multiteste, limpando componentes com a utilização de produtos químicos específicos e realizando outras atividades, visando o pleno funcionamento de equipamentos, instalações e infra-estrutura do Contrato. Realizar operações em LINHAS DE ALTA TENSÃO no caso de queda de energia e mediante autorização da Light, efetuando manobras e transferências de ramais de acordo com os equipamentos e procedimentos de segurança requeridos, a fim de possibilitar a religação da força necessária ao atendimento das necessidades do Contrato. Executar a manutenção preventiva de NO BREAK, efetuando a leitura de parâmetros e a medição de corrente elétrica, reapertando peças, limpando componentes e trocando baterias, a fim de manter as condições de operacionalidade requeridas. Executar a manutenção preventiva de SUBESTAÇÕES, limpando componentes, reapertando e lubrificando peças, medindo a voltagem de baterias, trocando fusíveis, verificando o funcionamento de quadro de capacitores, nível de óleo combustível e lubrificante de motores e estado de conservação de correias e mangueiras, bem como, inspecionando ruídos, aquecimentos e outras anormalidades, a fim de propiciar o pleno funcionamento de equipamentos e infra-estrutura do Contrato. Operar Subestações no caso de falta de energia elétrica, acompanhando a ligação automática do equipamento e desligando o Gerador no restabelecimento da força, visando o pleno fornecimento de energia para máquinas e instalações do Contrato. Efetuar a manutenção preventiva de TRANSFORMADORES, reapertando e lubrificando peças. Efetuar a leitura de plantas, desenhos e diagramas elétricos. Emitir formulário específico (Laudo), detalhando tipos de problemas, setores, equipamentos e outras informações referentes aos serviços executados, para fins de controle e informação à Chefia. Efetuar anotações em Livro de Ocorrências, indicando os eventos ocorridos, serviços executados, horários, datas e outras informações pertinentes, a fim de possibilitar o controle dos serviços de manutenção. Atuar em outras especialidades de manutenção elétrica conforme a necessidade. Orientar os demais profissionais da equipe, dirimindo dúvidas e indicando procedimentos, a fim de agilizar os trabalhos de manutenção.

title: Engineer II, Sustainability
description:
Description

The Engineer II, Sustainability will be responsible for supporting the activities of the Global Sustainability team related to GHG emissions from marine and offshore vessels/assets as well as activities associated with other sustainability-related projects. These include but are not limited to benchmarking, statistical analysis, and sustainability reporting.

What You Will Do:

  • Maintain a solid understanding of emerging regulatory framework related to GHG emissions and waste streams
  • Support the department's different projects, services, and other activities.
  • Interact with clients to perform services offered by the Global Sustainability team and identify/resolve problems with technical expertise.
  • Establish and manage client projects.
  • May update and inform the Global Sustainability team on regulatory changes and their impact on ABS business.
  • May conduct seminars and workshops related to the environmental performance of marine vessels and offshore units.
  • Support the associated service delivery across all geographic locations of Sustainability (Houston, Athens, Copenhagen, Singapore).
  • May contribute to authoring ABS publications and thought leadership documents. 
  • Maintain awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate
  • May attend industry events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends
  • Communicates the status of the current workload to all appropriate members of the team to ensure the needs of the clients will be met
  • May identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company's CRM
  • Works as a team member within the group, but may work autonomously most of the time

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Requires a BSc in Naval Architecture, Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field with a focus on environmental performance.
  • MSc degree preferred.
  • Requires a minimum of four (4) years of related engineering experience in a recognized research university, research institute, shipyard, design/consulting office, shipping/oil company, or a classification society. 
  • Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Experience with either marine or offshore applications.
  • Knowledge of GHG regulations, impacts, and technology transition.
  • Experience with programming and advanced use of MS Office.
  • Must be capable of presenting and working with clients
  • Knowledge of related technical disciplines required
  • The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems (i.e., the competence to demonstrate complex problem-solving skills)
  • Ability to work well with others
  • Excellent communication skills (oral & written), enabling effective communication at multiple levels
  • Strong commitment to ethical business practices, in full accordance with relevant corporate policies
  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy. 
  • Obtain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Reporting Relationships:

Reports to a Manager, Director, or Executive level position.

title: Manager, Volunteer System
description:
Department: Events & Entertainment
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.
The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.
We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.
Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
Act as the volunteer department's main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in-line with FIFA's data protection standards.
Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision-making.
Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct "Train-the-Trainer" sessions for system users.
Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost-effective delivery methods.
Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
Ensure a structured systems close-out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
Represent the Volunteer team in cross-functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.
YOUR PROFILE
Minimum 5 years of experience in large-scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
Education: Master's in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
Proven experience managing large-scale technology or systems implementation projects.
Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
High cultural awareness with experience in multi-stakeholder and multicultural environments.
Training delivery experience a plus
Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
Team player with internal and external stakeholders
Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast-paced environment.
Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community-building, sport, and service.
Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
Right to work in Brazil.
Fluent in English (spoken and written)
Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
